shorts.title: The Loudest Animal on Earth Clicks Through Its Nose
shorts.outro: Doug dies seven times on this dive. The full video is below.
shorts.description: A sperm whale's click reaches 236 decibels and carries more than 60 km underwater; Doug's whole two-kilometre dive with it is in the full episode.

shorts.title: The Man Swallowed by a Sperm Whale Never Existed
shorts.outro: Doug dies seven times further down. The full video is below.
shorts.description: The 1891 story of James Bartley surviving inside a sperm whale falls apart on the crew list; watch Doug follow the real whale down in the full episode.

shorts.title: A Sperm Whale Got Tangled in a Cable a Kilometer Down
shorts.outro: The whole two-kilometer dive, and Doug's seven deaths, are in the full video below.
shorts.description: In 1957 a geologist found sperm whales snared in seafloor cables as deep as 1,134 m, jaws first in the mud; the rest of Doug's dive is in the full episode.
